root.label: Marist September 2026 poll on Postal Service mail ballot delivery confidence

events.label: Marist September 2026 poll on Postal Service mail ballot delivery confidence

slots.name: delivery confidence
slots.sentence: Confidence that the Postal Service would deliver mail ballots on time plummeted among Democrats from 86% before the 2024 election to 60% now, according to polling conducted by Marist in September, just after the Supreme Court blocked the new Postal Service rules from going into effect.
